candidate.claim: The original notice date is definitively October 31, 2025.
candidate.target: DMV Electronic Lien and Titling second modification

evidence.quote:
# SECOND NOTICE OF MODIFICATIONS TO TEXT OF PROPOSED REGULATIONS AND ADDITION OF DOCUMENTS TO RULEMAKING FILE

Pursuant to the requirements of Government Code section 11346.8(c), and section 44 of Title 1 of the California Code of Regulations, the Department of Motor Vehicles is providing a second notice of changes made to proposed regulations originally noticed to the public in the California Regulatory Notice Register on October 31, 2025, related to the Electronic Lien and Titling Program. A Notice of Modification was also provided to the public on April 23, 2026.

The department also has available the notice of proposed regulatory action, the initial statement of reasons, the forms referenced in the proposed text, and the original regulatory language related to the proposed action that was provided to the public on October 31, 2026. The department also has available the notice, the modified text, the statement of reasons for the modifications, and the form and templates referenced in the modified text that were provided to the public for comment on April 23, 2026. The contact person identified in this notice shall, upon request, make these documents, forms, and templates available to the public.

Most documents can also be accessed on the department's Regulatory Actions webpage at: https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/about-the-california-department-of-motor-vehicles/california-dmv-rulemaking-actions/. Those documents that are not available online are available by requesting them at the email address provided.
